note: A shared brand property code is proof of a duplicate that street identity can miss: one row may state no address at all, and two rows may spell the same street differently. Recorded so the detector is on the record, not just its result. In each pair the COMMITTED, already-routed identity survives; the discovery row contributes only fields the committed row was missing, and nothing is renamed. A shared official URL proves the same thing a shared property code does, and is included here for the same reason.
